title: phase-ports shared domain types
description: The six structural types that flow across the seven TICK port boundaries, plus the Workspace passed to IMPLEMENT. phase-ports owns these types (v1 decision 7).
deprecation_criterion: superseded when per-port independent contract versioning replaces the single-bundle version (deferred to v2)

WorkItem.description: A raw unit of pulled work, the output of PULL and input of TRIAGE.

WorkOrder.description: A triaged, actionable order produced by TRIAGE and prioritized by PRIORITIZE.

ExecutionPlan.description: The ordered plan PRIORITIZE emits: a sequence of work order ids plus optional parallel groups.

Handoff.description: The result IMPLEMENT hands to VERIFY.

Verdict.description: The pass/fail judgement VERIFY emits for a Handoff.

IntegrationResult.description: The result INTEGRATE emits for a batch of verdicts; input to CLEANUP.

Workspace.description: The isolated working state passed to IMPLEMENT alongside the WorkOrder. v1 exposes exactly two fields (decision 4); credential and quota fields are deferred.
